stories.title: AI shopping agents are having a moment, but Amazon and a growing number of sites threaten to stunt their growth
stories.summary: AI shopping agents from OpenAI, Meta, Google and Instinct promise to help users shop, but they're hitting roadblocks at Amazon and other retailers.
stories.zh_title: 人工智慧購物代理正在風靡一時，但亞馬遜和越來越多的網站可能會阻礙其發展
stories.zh_summary: OpenAI、Meta、Google 和 Instinct 的人工智慧購物代理承諾幫助用戶購物，但他們在亞馬遜和其他零售商處遇到了障礙。

stories.title: The S&P 500 is in a correction. Bear markets and recessions don't always follow
stories.summary: The November sell-off has so far pushed the S&P 500 into a correction. History shows that a correction doesn't always lead to a bear market, or a recession.

stories.zh_summary: 迄今為止，11 月的拋售已推動標準普爾 500 指數進入回檔。歷史表明，調整併不總是會導致熊市或經濟衰退。
